title: slice run leaves the journal unchanged when it refuses --override
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run --override` refused with 64 (head or base changed, or no reviewed FAIL) leaves the journal byte-identical, so a completed stage is not rerun.
Evidence: PR #206 review record 2 finding "Odrzucony override zmienia journal", confirmed REAL by the independent verifier (.krn/runs/lead/review-override/verdict.md): journal {stage:pr, completed:true} becomes completed:false, exitCode:64. Fix: set `writable = false` before the 64 throw in src/slice/run.ts.
Proof: an observer that refuses --override on a completed-stage journal and asserts journal.json is unchanged; plus a failed override (non-zero exit) leaves stage review.
